name: Tsurugi Otome Noah
source:
The main character is Haruto, a soldier. One day, he loses his life during a battle. To get back to life, he'll need to get the energy of other people. However, it's hard to do so.... Just when he gives up, Noah and Firia stop him. They decide to offer their bodies to him....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305043019/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1007870]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公春人是一名士兵。某天，他在战斗中丧生。若想复活，必须获得他人的能量，然而这并不容易……正当他准备放弃时，诺亚和菲莉娅阻止了他。她们决定向他献出身体……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305043019/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1007870]Eroge Shop[/url]]
